name: 100x-search-query
description: Validation tooling for the 100x-search-query skill (SearchQueryBundle output contract). Not published -- this package.json exists only so scripts/validate.js can pull in ajv for real JSON Schema enforcement (structural checks: required/additionalProperties/enum/pattern) instead of a hand-rolled re-implementation that quietly missed additionalProperties. Cross-item/aggregate checks that JSON Schema draft-07 cannot express (axiom 2 density, axiom 3 5A coverage, sensitive-category detection) stay hand-written in scripts/validate.js -- see that file's header comment and axioms.md.
